Title: Raynaud's phenomenon affects 3-5% of people, and most miss these 3 hidden factors

Description:
Ordinary cold hands stay uniformly cold. Raynaud's phenomenon is different - your finger blood vessels spasm suddenly, turning skin white, then blue, then red in a sharp pattern.

Caffeine and stimulants, nicotine, and low magnesium are three factors that make attacks worse - and each one has a simple fix.

Watch to find out why they matter, and what actually helps.
